STATE OF GEORGIA
IN THE STATE COURT OF FULTON COUNTY

THE STATE OF GEORGIA
v.
MARCUS JEROME WILLIAMS

Case No. 2024-SC-04821

ACCUSATION

COMES NOW the undersigned prosecutor, and in the name and behalf of the
citizens of Georgia, charges and accuses MARCUS JEROME WILLIAMS with the
offenses hereinafter described:

COUNT I - POSSESSION OF A CONTROLLED SUBSTANCE
O.C.G.A. § 16-13-30(a)

On or about February 3, 2024, at approximately 11:45 PM, in the City of
Atlanta, County of Fulton, State of Georgia, the accused, MARCUS JEROME
WILLIAMS, did unlawfully possess less than one ounce of a substance
containing marijuana, a controlled substance listed in Schedule I of the
Georgia Controlled Substances Act, in violation of O.C.G.A. § 16-13-30(a).

Said substance weighed approximately 0.8 ounces and was discovered during
a search of the accused's vehicle.

COUNT II - OBSTRUCTION OF A LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICER
O.C.G.A. § 16-10-24(a)

On or about February 3, 2024, at approximately 11:45 PM, in the City of
Atlanta, County of Fulton, State of Georgia, the accused, MARCUS JEROME
WILLIAMS, did knowingly and willfully obstruct and hinder Officer Derek
Thompson, Badge #5892, Atlanta Police Department, Zone 5, a law enforcement
officer in the lawful discharge of his official duties, by refusing to exit
his vehicle when lawfully ordered to do so and by pulling away from the
officer when the officer attempted to place him in handcuffs, in violation
of O.C.G.A. § 16-10-24(a).

FACTUAL BASIS:

On February 3, 2024, at approximately 11:30 PM, Officer Derek Thompson,
Badge #5892, Atlanta Police Department Zone 5, was conducting a routine
traffic stop of a 2019 Honda Accord, Georgia tag ABC-1234, at the
intersection of Martin Luther King Jr. Drive and Joseph E. Lowery Boulevard.

The vehicle was stopped for a broken taillight. Upon approaching the vehicle,
Officer Thompson detected a strong odor of marijuana emanating from the
vehicle interior.

Officer Thompson asked the driver, later identified as MARCUS JEROME WILLIAMS
(DOB: 08/22/1995, address: 456 Auburn Ave NE, Apt 3B, Atlanta, GA 30312),
to step out of the vehicle. The accused initially refused to exit and
stated "I haven't done anything wrong." After approximately two minutes,
the accused exited the vehicle.

When Officer Thompson attempted to conduct a pat-down search, the accused
pulled his right arm away and stepped back. Officer Thompson then placed
the accused in handcuffs. Backup was requested and Officer Sarah Mitchell,
Badge #6215, APD Zone 5, arrived at approximately 11:42 PM.

Officer Thompson conducted a search of the vehicle incident to arrest and
discovered a clear plastic bag containing a green leafy substance in the
center console. The substance field-tested positive for marijuana and
weighed approximately 0.8 ounces. Evidence Tag #EV-2024-0213.

The accused was read his Miranda rights at approximately 11:50 PM by
Officer Mitchell. The accused stated he understood his rights and said
"That's not mine, my friend left it in there." No further statements
were made.

The accused was transported to APD Zone 5 precinct for booking at
approximately 12:15 AM on February 4, 2024.

WITNESS LIST:
1. Officer Derek Thompson, Badge #5892, APD Zone 5 (arresting officer)
2. Officer Sarah Mitchell, Badge #6215, APD Zone 5 (assisting officer)
3. Jasmine Carter (passenger in the vehicle at time of stop)

EVIDENCE:
- One (1) clear plastic bag containing green leafy substance (marijuana),
  approximately 0.8 ounces, Evidence Tag #EV-2024-0213
- Field test kit #FT-2024-1147 (positive for THC)
- Body camera footage from Officer Thompson (BWC-5892-20240203)
- Body camera footage from Officer Mitchell (BWC-6215-20240203)
- Vehicle registration for 2019 Honda Accord, GA tag ABC-1234

This ___ day of February, 2024.
